description: MetaRalph Phase 4: CLI Dashboard - Terminal UI with real-time views for queue, approvals, projects, workers, and conversations.

userStories.title: Set up Ink dashboard framework
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Ink framework set up so that we can build React-based terminal UI components.
acceptanceCriteria: Keyboard: Tab/1-5 switches views, q quits
Header shows: 'MetaRalph v{version}' and daemon status

userStories.title: Implement Queue view component
userStories.description: As a user, I need to see the work queue in the dashboard with filtering and sorting.
acceptanceCriteria: src/cli/components/QueueView.tsx shows all tasks in a table
Columns: Priority, ID, Project, Type, Status, Effort
Filter dropdown: All, Pending, Queued, Running, Completed

userStories.title: Implement Approvals view component
userStories.description: As a user, I need to review and approve/reject pending tasks from the dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows full task details: title, description, source, rationale
Keyboard: 'a' approves, 'r' rejects (prompts for reason), 'n' next, 'p' previous
Updates in real-time as tasks are submitted

userStories.title: Implement Projects view component
userStories.description: As a user, I need to manage projects and groups from the dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: src/cli/components/ProjectsView.tsx shows projects grouped by group
Shows: name, path, health score, last analyzed, active workers

userStories.title: Implement Workers view component
userStories.description: As a user, I need to monitor active Ralph workers in real-time.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows: ID, Project, Task, Started, Duration, Iteration X/Y
Live output tail (last 5 lines) for selected worker
'l' opens full log view for worker

userStories.title: Implement Logs view component
userStories.description: As a user, I need to see MetaRalph system logs in the dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Filter by level: debug, info, warn, error
